titleEn: Royal decree no. 1022/1292 on the adjustment of administrative boundaries between Pailin and Battambang provinces

articles.en:
The administrative boundaries between Pailin Province and Battambang Province shall be adjusted as follows: - the administrative boundary between Pailin Municipality of Pailin Province and Samlout District of Battambang Province shall be adjusted by transferring the geographical area of Phnom Dambang in Mean Chey Commune, Samlout District, Battambang Province, with a total area of 6.685 hectares, to the administration of Ou Ta Re Community, Pailin Municipality, Pailin Province, with the Sangke River fixed as the administrative boundary line.
- the administrative boundary between Sala Krau District of Pailin Province and Kamrieng District of Battambang Province shall be adjusted by transferring Lak Hok Pir Village and Boeng Ou Cheang Village of Kamrieng Commune, Kamrieng District, Battambang Province, with a total area of 1.376 hectares, to the administration of Stung Karb Commune, Sala Krau District, Pailin Province, and by transferring Kampong Chamlong Krom Village of Ta Krei Commune, Kamrieng District, Battambang Province, with a total area of 3.618 hectares, to the administration of Sala Krau Commune, Sala Krau District, Pailin Province, with the Mongkol Borei River fixed as the administrative boundary line.
On the basis of this adjustment, the administrative boundary between Pailin Province and Battambang Province shall be determined as shown in the map annexed to this Royal Decree.
All provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

= Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
[Illegible in source: seal and registration number]
Norodom Sihamoni; at the Royal Palace, 05 October 2022; certified true copy of the original; Minister in charge of the Council of Ministers, Kitti Nitikosol Bandit Bin Chhin.
